definition: to be in a tangible form.
example_en: God appeared to the devotees taking a tangible form as an idol.

definition: either of the two forelimbs of most birds and of bats that are specialised for flight; the wing.
example_en: The bird spread its wings and flew.

definition: (gram.) the first of the nine cases; nominative case.
example_en: In the nominative case the subject word is prominent.

definition: a good or required score got in the game of dice.
example_en: In the game of dice, he got the required winning score.

definition: the plant Phaseolus aconitifolius ( = Dolichos dissectus) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmers grew the madaki plant in the field.

definition: vegetable - a) any herbaceous plant that is eaten whole or in part, raw or cooked b) the edible part of such a plant, as the root (e.g., a carrot), tuber (a potato), seed (a pea), fruit (a tomato), stem (celery) or leaf (lettuce).
example_en: The vegetables grown in the garden are tasty.

definition: the state of being utterly perplexed.
example_en: When he lost his way, he was utterly perplexed.

definition: to burn ablaze.
example_en: The fire was burning ablaze in the hearth.

definition: any of broad-bodied, four-winged, six-footed, hairy hymenopteran insects which belong to a large super family Apoidea, which gather pollen and nectar, have biting as well as sucking mouthparts, and often live in organised colonies; a bee.
example: ಆರ್ಕಾಲುಗಳು ಹೂವಿನ ಮಕರಂದವನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು ತೋಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾರಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The bees fly around the garden to collect nectar from the flowers.

definition: emitting or reflecting highly efficiently and evenly; very brilliant.
example_en: A very brilliant star shone in the sky.

definition: the state of the mind in which it has perfect communion or association with the higher planes of consciousness or a divinity; deep and abstract meditation.
example_en: The sage sat immersed in deep meditation.

definition: to stay at a place for a short period.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರು ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬೀಡುಗೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The travellers stayed in that town for one night.

definition: the far off shore.
example_en: The ship took days to reach the far off shore.

definition: to get, earn fame.
example_en: That poet earned fame through his poetry.

definition: the quality or fact of being not porous.
example: ಆ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯ ನಿಶ್ಛಿದ್ರತೆ ನೀರು ಸೋರದಂತೆ ಕಾಪಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The non-porosity of that vessel kept the water from leaking.

definition: to be plundered, looted.
example_en: The whole province was plundered by the invaders.

definition: to send - a) to cause to go or be carried; to dispatch, convey or transmit; b) to dispatch, convey or transmit (a letter, message, etc.) by mail.
example_en: Mother sent the letter by post.

definition: a man who is offended, slighted.
example_en: Feeling insulted, he went home offended and slighted.

definition: the celestial painter, sculptor.
example_en: The celestial painter decorated the temple walls.

definition: the sensation produced by a loss or absence of heat; coolness; coldness.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿರ್ಮೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The coolness is felt very well on top of the hill.

definition: a dear, beloved man.
example_en: Everyone looked at that beloved man with affection.

definition: brown hair.
example_en: Her brown hair was fluttering in the wind.

definition: a loud, deep, rumbling sound, as of a lion, bull, person or crowd shouting, etc.; sound of roaring.
example_en: The lion's roar shook the entire forest.

definition: to create deliberately hope in the mind of another (to get something done); to willfully cause another to have expectations.
example_en: He gave a false promise and created hope deliberately in another's mind.

definition: imperfection; a blemish; a flaw.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಕುದುರು ಒಂದು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small flaw in that cloth.

definition: (astrol.) the sixth sign of the zodiac, which the sun enters about 23 August; Virgo.
example_en: The sun enters Virgo at the end of August.

definition: an embankment at the gate of a city or fort.
example_en: The guards were standing on the embankment at the city gate.

definition: to hold the air taken into the lungs without exhaling.
example_en: Before diving into the water he held his breath.

definition: a large number of things, gathered together or considered as a unit; a host; a multitude.
example_en: A multitude of people had gathered at the fair.

definition: the quality of being long; longness.
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಸೇಯ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The longness of that cloth drew everyone's attention.

definition: connection of persons by blood, marriage, etc.; kinship; relation.
example_en: Kinship grew between the two families through marriage.

definition: a very glad feeling; joy; happiness; pleasure; delight.
example_en: He was filled with great joy on hearing the result.

definition: an activity engaged in for amusement or recreation; a play for fun.
example_en: The children are playing a game for fun in the courtyard.

definition: a stringed bow.
example_en: The hunter used the curved, stringed bow and shot an arrow.

definition: to sit on a swing.
example_en: The child happily sat on the swing.

definition: a kind of pigeon, whose entrance into the house, is considered inauspicious.
example_en: Grandmother got frightened when the inauspicious pigeon entered the house.

definition: (pl.) the families of a town.
example_en: All the families of the town gathered for the festival.

definition: to cover as to shield (something) from danger, injury, etc.
example_en: He shielded the child from the rain.

definition: to become dirty; to be defiled.
example_en: The clothes became dirty from the rain.

definition: a syllable used in singing.
example: ಹಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಲೆ ಎಂಬ ಸ್ವರಾಕ್ಷರ ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಬರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The syllable 'lēle' recurred again and again in the song.

definition: to join, meet again.
example_en: Both the friends met again during the festival.

definition: a lender supply of water from underground.
example_en: Because there was a rich underground water supply, the well did not dry up.

definition: the act or process of robbing, esp. with force or threat of force; plundering.
example_en: The robbers plundered the travellers.

definition: a prominent, bulging out forehead.
example_en: That boy had a prominent, bulging forehead.

definition: to hold across; to project as a shield.
example_en: The soldier projected his shield across and stopped the attack.

definition: any of two or more quantities which form a product when multiplied together, but not divisible by any whole number except 1.
example: ಈ ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಅಪವರ್ತನಗಳನ್ನು ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: If you multiply these prime factors, you get a large number.

definition: (dial.) a flight of stairs; a stairway; a staircase.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಜಿನೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮೇಲಿನ ಕೋಣೆಗೆ ಹೋದೆವು.
example_en: We went up to the upper room through the house's staircase.

definition: he who or that which is to be, fit to be killed.
example: ಅಪರಾಧಿಯನ್ನು ವಧ್ಯ ಎಂದು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ತೀರ್ಪು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The court ruled the criminal fit to be killed.

definition: the quality or state of being respectable; respectaility.
example_en: His respectability was known to everyone in the village.

definition: lack of strength; weakness.
example_en: Weakness appeared in the body because of fever.

definition: (fire) to burn with blazing flames.
example_en: The firewood burned with blazing flames in the stove.

definition: transported, conveyed to the other end.
example_en: The goods were transported to the port.

definition: an unfavourable time or circumstance.
example_en: People suffered during that unfavourable time.

definition: a kind of rose plant (of Rosaceae family).
example_en: They had grown a rose plant in the courtyard.

definition: an interjection to express astonishment, pain or fatigue.
example_en: A stone hit his foot, and he cried "Ouch!"

definition: a house of prostitution; a brothel.
example_en: The police raided the brothel.

definition: a wealthy man.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಧನವಂತ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That town's wealthy man helps the poor.

definition: a horse; Equus caballus.
example_en: The horse ran swiftly across the meadow.

definition: a falling drop; a drop of water that is seeping out.
example: ಮಾಡಿನಿಂದ ಒಱೆವನಿ ಅವನ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A seeping drop of water from the roof fell on his head.

definition: a man who carries messages, reports, etc. from one place to another; a courier.
example_en: The king's courier came carrying the message.

definition: the dead body of an elephant; an elephant's carcass.
example_en: The elephant's carcass lay rotting in the forest.

definition: an area of land almost completely surrounded by water except for an isthmus connecting it with the mainland; a peninsula.
example: ಆ ಭೂಭಾಗವು ಮೂರು ಕಡೆ ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಸುತ್ತುವರೆದ ದ್ವೀಪಕಲ್ಪ.
example_en: That landmass is a peninsula surrounded by water on three sides.

definition: the remarkably high capacity for exertion or endurance; much strength.
example_en: Everyone was astonished seeing his great strength and endurance.

definition: a thick staff; a cudgel.
example_en: The watchman had a sturdy cudgel in his hand.

definition: a pair of linked buttons or any similar small device for keeping a shirt cuff closed; a cuff-link.
example: ಅವನು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಇತ್ತಲೆಗುಂಡಿ ಧರಿಸಿ ಸಭೆಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came to the meeting wearing gold cuff-links.

definition: a duration of thirty seconds.
example_en: Half a minute is enough to finish this work.

definition: a kind of pickle of cucumber.
example_en: Grandmother made cucumber pickle.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The pannīrele plant has grown well in the garden.

definition: a kind of bird.
example_en: In the morning a korasu bird was calling.

definition: to be left untilled, unploughed; to become fallow.
example_en: Due to lack of rain, the field remained untilled and fallow.

definition: limestone that is boiling (as in the process of extracting lime from it).
example_en: Limestone was boiling in the kiln.

definition: one who rows the boat; a boatman.
example_en: The boatman rowed the boat across the river.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating, deceiving; deception.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಮೋಸದಿಂದ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಹಣವನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Because of the merchant's deception, he lost all his money.

definition: the plant Symplocos gardeneriana of Symplocaceae family.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಇಳಿಜಾರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಕಣಿ ಗಿಡವು ಹೂವು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ.
example_en: The Symplocos gardeneriana plant has bloomed on the slope of the hill.

definition: a large wave; great swell of water; a billow.
example_en: A great billow rose in the sea.

definition: a man who is an agent for a prostitute or prostitutes and lives off their earnings; a procurer; a pimp.
example_en: The people of the village despised that pimp.

definition: an apparatus with a central pivot, beam (with a fulcrum at the centre), and two scales used for weighing; a balance.
example_en: The merchant weighed the goods on the balance and gave them.

definition: a reddish variety of oligoclase feldspar, used as a gem, having a red and bright-yellow play of colour.
example: ಅವಳ ಕೊರಳಿನ ಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಲ್ ಕಲ್ಲು ಕೆಂಪಾಗಿ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The sun-stone in her necklace shone red.

definition: an outcast or barbarian.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ನಿಷ್ಟ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: In those days he was called an outcast.

definition: a land surface with a gentle slope.
example_en: Rainwater flowed slowly over that gently sloping land.

definition: the plant Atalantia monophylla (= Limonia monophylle) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: Wild-lime plants had grown at the forest's edge.

definition: a silicate of zirconium, ZrSiO4, a mineral found in igneous and sedimentary rocks and occurring in tetragonal crystals coloured yellow, brown, red, etc., transparent varieties of which are used as gems; zircon.
example: ಆ ಮಣಿಯನ್ನು ಗೋಮೇದಕ ಎಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಕರು ದೃಢಪಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The examiner confirmed that the gem was zircon.

definition: a type of black stone formerly used to test the purity of gold or silver by the streak left on it when it was rubbed with the metal; a touchstone.
example: ಅಕ್ಕಸಾಲಿಗನು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಶುದ್ಧತೆಯನ್ನು ಒರೆಗಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಜ್ಜಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The goldsmith tested the purity of the gold by rubbing it on the touchstone.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರ ನಡುವಿನ ಪೊರ್ದುಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಸಂಭ್ರಮ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The harmony among the villagers increased the festivity's joy.

definition: an increasing or becoming increased; growth, enlargement; increase.
example_en: This year an increase in prices has been seen.

definition: a process of printing from a plate, etc. prepared by methods combining photography and lithography; photolithography.
example: ಆ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಂತಿಮುದ್ರಣ ವಿಧಾನದಿಂದ ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The pictures in that book were printed using the photolithography method.

definition: a children's play sliding over a smooth, declining surface.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪಾರ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾರುಗುಪ್ಪೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾರಿ ಆಡಿದರು.
example_en: The children played by sliding on the slide in the park.

definition: an electric discharge with lightning an thunder; a thunderbolt.
example_en: During the rainy season there is fear of a thunderbolt falling.

definition: the larva of certain amphibians, as frogs, having gills and a tail and living in water; a tadpole.
example_en: The tadpole was swimming in the water.

definition: to live at a place as a resident for a considerable period.
example_en: He lived as a resident in Mumbai for work.

definition: any intoxicating drink.
example_en: He got intoxicated after drinking the liquor.

definition: a drama written mainly to be read and not staged; a closet play.
example_en: This closet play is not meant to be staged.

definition: he who is highly regarded, honoured.
example_en: Everyone honoured that highly regarded teacher.

definition: to do; to perform (an action).
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಆಜ್ಞೆಯಂತೆ ಶಿಷ್ಯನು ಆ ಕಾರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮಾಣ್ದನು.
example_en: The disciple performed that task as per the teacher's order.

definition: trembling, shaking or quivering (as from cold).
example_en: His body was trembling from the cold.

definition: to make a hole in or through with or as with a drill or other rotating tool; to bore; to drill.
example_en: The worker drilled a hole in the wall.

definition: the biennial herb Carum carvi of Apiaceae family, with white flower; caraway.
example_en: She put caraway powder into the sambar.

definition: a narrow, long, lose cloth for tying round the head as a headgear.
example_en: He tied the narrow long cloth around his head as a headgear.

definition: a huge rock.
example_en: There was a huge rock on the river bank.

definition: difficult situation; distress; strait; trouble.
example_en: The debt caused him great distress.

definition: a repairing of or replacing of worn and broken parts of, something; renovation.
example_en: The renovation work of the old house began.

definition: (beauty) to be spoiled.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದು ಅವಳ ಮುಖದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ಪಸಗೆಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Walking in the sun, the beauty of her face got spoiled.

definition: the state of being emotionally disturbed; agitation.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಆಕೆಯ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾೞ್ಗುದಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news, agitation arose in her mind.

definition: a little respect or prestige.
example: ಆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗೆಲುವಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಳಿಗರ್ವ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: He gained a little prestige from that small victory.

definition: properly; in a manner fit for the purpose.
example_en: He did and finished everything properly.

definition: a character in epic Mahābhārata, the ignominious role-model for cowards.
example_en: People mocked him as an Uttarakumara-like coward.

definition: something used to apply on the surface of.
example_en: A good face cream is needed for winter.

definition: (a plant) to have new leaf grown.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ನಂತರ ಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ಸುೞಿವಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: After the rain came, the mango tree put out new leaves.

definition: to push (an object or a person) to one's left.
example_en: He pushed the cart to the left and made way.

definition: a kind of substance that explodes; an explosive.
example_en: They used an explosive to break the rock in the mine.

definition: the act or fact of removing, preventing or warding of (an evil).
example_en: Retaliation against injustice became unavoidable.

definition: a prolonged period of famine and drought.
example_en: That region was shaken by a prolonged famine and drought.

definition: the grass Cyperus rotundus(= C. hexastachyus) of Cyperaceae family.
example_en: The nagamuttu grass has grown abundantly in the field.

definition: any of several genera of large eared seals without underfur, usu. living in colonies along the coastline of the Pacific Ocean; a sea lion.
example: ಪೆಸಿಫಿಕ್ ಸಾಗರ ತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಲಸಿಂಹಗಳು ಗುಂಪಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: Sea lions were seen in colonies along the Pacific coast.

definition: (bot.) the state of having a single stamen; monandry.
example_en: A single-stamen structure is seen in this flower.

definition: a place where animals are killed for meat; a slaughterhouse; a butchery.
example_en: They kill animals at the slaughterhouse.

definition: a beautiful, lovely gait.
example_en: The swan's beautiful gait charmed the onlookers.

definition: the region under or towards one's feet.
example_en: The child was lying near the mother's feet.

definition: an instrument for weighing, esp. one that opposes equal weights, as in two matched shallow pans hanging from either end of a lever supported exactly in the middle; scales; a balance.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed the jaggery on a balance.

definition: to blow air in puffs from the mouth.
example_en: He blew puffs of air from his mouth to put out the fire.

definition: a shrub of bamboos.
example_en: The bamboo shrub fell and blocked the path.

definition: (a condition, situation) to be characterised by mourning; to be depressing or melancholy.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಸಾವಿನ ನಂತರ ಗೋೞ್ಗೆಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The atmosphere of that house became melancholy after the death.

definition: green; verdant.
example_en: In the monsoon, the hills appeared lush green.

definition: the foam of milk.
example_en: When the milk was heated, the foam of milk appeared on top.

definition: (hist.) a monetary coin that was current in erstwhile Maisūru (Mysore) state.
example_en: The rajarupayi coin was in circulation in the old Mysore state.

definition: (a bird) to open the beak.
example_en: The crow opened its beak and cawed.

definition: an earthen vessel; a pot.
example_en: Grandmother brought water in an earthen pot.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example_en: The new mother cleaned the baby's navel.

definition: the office, status of a minister.
example_en: He held the office of minister for ten years.

definition: the entire physical structure of a living being; the body.
example_en: They carried the dead man's body with respect.

definition: a panting breath; difficulty in breathing.
example_en: The boy who came running started panting for breath.

definition: an inference or deduction.
example_en: That researcher's inference was correct.

definition: a number of cattle feeding, living or being driven together; a herd.
example_en: The herd of cattle was moving towards the field.

definition: a flash of light (lasting a very short time).
example_en: The brief flash of lightning vanished in an instant.

definition: a tall spar or, now often, a hollow metal structure, sometimes in sections, rising vertically from the keel or deck of a vessel and used to support the sails, yards, radar and radio equipment, etc. ; the mast of a vessel.
example_en: The new ship's mast was very tall.

definition: a desireless, passionless man.
example: ಆ ಸಾಧು ವಿತೃಷ್ಣನಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಯಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೊರೆದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That sage was desireless, having renounced all wishes.

definition: a kind of sleeved upper garment worn by men.
example_en: He wore a new sleeved upper garment for the festival.

definition: pleasant speech.
example_en: Her pleasant speech won everyone's heart.

definition: a shrill sounding blowpipe.
example_en: The shepherd blew the shrill pipe and called his sheep.

definition: any of various dark-coloured, viscid products with pungent odour obtained from the destructive distillation of certain organic substances, as coal, peat, shale or wood, used for protecting and preserving surfaces; tar.
example_en: The smell of tar had spread throughout the street.

definition: a running away from; the act of escaping; an escape.
example_en: His escape from the prison startled everyone.

definition: to collapse suddenly.
example_en: The wall collapsed suddenly due to the rain.

definition: a single finger.
example_en: They bandaged one of her fingers.

definition: one round; a single round; a coming around (something) once only; a single turn.
example: ಓಟಗಾರ ಮೈದಾನದ ಸುತ್ತ ಒರ್ಬಳಸು ಓಡಿ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: The runner ran a single round around the field.

definition: any of the art forms that include drawing, painting; fine-art.
example_en: Painting is a beautiful fine art.

definition: to lose one's reputation, status or prestige.
example_en: Because of that mistake, he lost his prestige.

definition: agreable or friendly relations; harmony.
example_en: The friendly relations between them lasted a long time.

definition: the hollow under the arm at the shoulder; the armpit.
example_en: The doctor examined the armpit and gave medicine.

definition: the office, duty, status of an ambassador.
example_en: He carried out the office of ambassador for many years.

definition: firmly; fast.
example_en: He held the pillar firmly and fast.

definition: the bluish green sea-fish Clupea leigaster.
example_en: The fisherman caught a dondi fish in his net.

definition: the Gangā river.
example: ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಂದಿನಿಯನ್ನು ಪವಿತ್ರ ನದಿ ಎಂದು ಬಣ್ಣಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In the puranas, the Ganga is described as a sacred river.

definition: mutual action; interaction.
example: ಎರಡು ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅಂತರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Good interaction took place between the two groups.

definition: a container, usu. with a lid, made of tin or other metal sheet; a can or tin.
example_en: Mother kept the biscuits in a tin.

definition: the state of being subject to strong influence of feelings, sentiments.
example: ಆ ಕವಿಯ ಬರಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾವಾವಿಷ್ಟತೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In that poet's writing, the state of being overwhelmed by emotion was clearly visible.

definition: she who rouses sexual feelings (in men).
example: ಆ ನಸೆಗಾರ್ತಿಯ ನೋಟ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The glance of that seductive woman drew everyone's attention in the gathering.

definition: a piece of land having mounds and pits.
example_en: Farming is difficult on that land full of mounds and pits.

definition: the end of a tooth.
example_en: The end of the tooth broke and the child felt pain.

definition: a conflict; a battle, war.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಯ್ಯುಗ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A great battle took place between those two kingdoms.

definition: a man who selects; a selector.
example_en: The committee appointed a new selector.

definition: a pair of straps or bands passed over the shoulders to hold up the trousers or a skirt; suspenders.
example_en: He had put on suspenders for his trousers.

definition: a fight, esp. a large-scale engagement, between armed forces of different countries or between factions with the same country, on land, at sea or in the air; a battle; a war.
example: ಎರಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಭೀಕರ ಕೊಳಗುಳ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A fierce war took place between the two kingdoms.

definition: bravery; prowess; valour; might.
example_en: The warrior's bravery inspired the whole army.

definition: a snake or serpent.
example_en: A serpent was crawling near the anthill.

definition: to notice or perceive; to observe; to identify.
example_en: Seeing his expression, she perceived the truth.

definition: to score or mark the surface of with a nail or nails.
example_en: The cat scratched the door with its nails.

definition: a payment of a fixed sum made or to be made yearly; annuity.
example: ರಾಜ ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಪೋಟಗಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: The king used to give that family an annuity every year.

definition: a gathering for social entertainment or the entertainment itself; a social party.
example: ಸಂಜೆ ಅವರ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಜಲಸಾ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A social party took place at their house in the evening.

definition: a large oven for drying, burning or baking bricks, pottery, etc.; a kiln.
example_en: They used the kiln to bake the bricks.

definition: the pleasant feeling got when one smiles.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನಗೆವೆಳಗು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news brought him a pleasant feeling of smiling.

definition: a condiment made of grain or pulse with chillies, salt, which is dried and fried in oil, used as relish.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಸೊಂಡಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಣ್ಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಿದು ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಬಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: Grandmother made the dried condiment and fried it in oil and served it with the meal.

definition: to work hard and earnestly; to endeavour; to strive.
example_en: He worked hard and strove earnestly to win in the examination.

definition: a leader or guide.
example: ಆ ಸಂಚಾರಕನು ಯಾತ್ರಿಕರನ್ನು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ದನು.
example_en: That guide led the pilgrims up the hill.

definition: one of the scheduled castes.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಆದಿಯ ಸಮುದಾಯದವರಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The government gave special facilities to people of the scheduled caste.

definition: to join one's voice harmoniously in a chorus.
example_en: The group of singers sang, joining their voices harmoniously in chorus.

definition: daily; every day.
example_en: He exercises daily every morning.

definition: a room in a harem, in which royal women would confine themselves to show their displeasure, dissatisfaction, anger, etc.
example_en: The queen showed her displeasure in the anger room.

definition: the woven or spun network of a spider; cobweb.
example_en: The cobweb is visible on the tree branch.

definition: a fortunate, lucky woman.
example: ಆ ಮಹೋದಯೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಿಂದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಪಡೆದಳು.
example_en: That fortunate woman achieved great success through her efforts.

definition: the time of life between puberty and maturity; youth.
example_en: In his youth his interests changed.

definition: a plant .
example_en: They have planted the uppuri plant in the garden.

definition: to emit rancid smell.
example_en: The broth left in the sun emitted a rancid smell.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The farmers grew kāḷisoppu in the field.

definition: black colour.
example_en: The artist drew the lines using black colour.

definition: to send a message or messages through a courier, runner or messenger.
example_en: He sent the letter through a messenger to the distant town.

definition: great joy, pleasure.
example_en: On hearing the result, he felt great joy.

definition: a man who has a sense of propriety and good taste in behaviour, dealings. etc.
example_en: He is a man of good taste and propriety, who behaves courteously with everyone.

definition: loose; slack; lax.
example_en: The rope was loose and snapped quickly.

definition: pleased; gratified; delighted.
example_en: The child was greatly delighted by that gift.

definition: rough and knotty.
example_en: The bark of that tree was rough and knotty.

definition: the trunks, bags, etc. of a traveller, esp. when packed and being used on a trip; luggage; baggage.
example_en: The traveller loaded his luggage onto the cart.

definition: a boon helping getting over or warding of, a curse.
example: ಋಷಿಗಳು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಉಚ್ಛಾಪ ನೀಡಿ ಶಾಪದಿಂದ ಪಾರುಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The sage gave him a boon and saved him from the curse.

definition: outstandingly good of its kind; of exceptional merit, virtue, etc.; excelling; excellent.
example: ಅವನ ಉಗ್ಗಡ ಕೆಲಸ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His outstandingly excellent work won everyone's admiration.

definition: a pair of beds.
example_en: A pair of beds had been arranged in the room.

definition: a good-looking, handsome man.
example_en: That handsome man was liked by everyone in the village.

definition: a small trumpet-like wind instrument.
example_en: The musician played a small trumpet.

definition: a man who is born in Karnāṭaka.
example_en: That man born in Karnataka spoke Kannada with pride.

definition: a succession of rulers who are members of the same family; dynasty.
example_en: The dynasty's rule continued for a long time.

definition: a servant of a king.
example_en: The king's servant carried and brought the message.

definition: the spinal column; backbone.
example_en: His backbone was slightly injured in the accident.

definition: thick darkness.
example_en: Thick darkness had spread inside the cave.

definition: excessive grief.
example_en: Excessive grief befell them due to poverty.

definition: a sagging ear.
example_en: The old man's sagging ear was drooping beside his face.

definition: a female relative; a kinswoman.
example_en: She is a kinswoman of my mother.

definition: a big, slow, stupid man.
example_en: That stupid, slow fellow did not do the work properly.

definition: to appeal - a) to appeal a law case to a higher court for reconsideration or revisit; b) to make an urgent request (to a person for help, sympathy, etc.).
example_en: He appealed against the judgement.

definition: to become available; to be got.
example_en: Through effort, a good job became available.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example_en: He was distressed by the loss in business.

definition: a man or a thing that inflames or helps burning.
example: ಆ ಭಾಷಣ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಉದ್ದೀಪಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That speech worked as an inflaming force for the people.

definition: the act of flattering; excessive, untrue or insincere praise of a person in his or her presence.
example_en: The master was pleased by his flattery.

definition: the cardinal number eighteen; 18.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪದಿನೆಂಟು ವರ್ಷ ತುಂಬಿದಾಗ ಮತದಾನದ ಹಕ್ಕು ಬಂತು.
example_en: He got the right to vote when he turned eighteen.

definition: praise; commendation.
example_en: The teacher received praise from the disciples.

definition: to come out of sleep or a state similar to sleep, stupor, trance etc.; to wake up.
example_en: Waking up from the dream, he was startled.

definition: a kind of plant .
example_en: They had planted the tāti plant in the courtyard.

definition: a loud, explosive, resounding noise produced by the explosive expansion of air heated by a lightning discharge of clouds; a thunder.
example_en: A loud thunder was suddenly heard in the sky.

definition: Śiva.
example_en: Devotees remember Rērihāṇa as Śiva.

definition: the act of approaching; a going near.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಉಪಗಮ ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The teacher's approach brought peace to the disciple's mind.

definition: the governance of a state, nation.
example_en: The governance of the state was entrusted to that minister.

definition: to be or become wrinkled, as by contracting; to pucker.
example_en: The cloth wrinkled and became creased in the sun.

definition: to agree willingly to; to consent.
example_en: The king willingly consented to that agreement.

definition: a place, distant from the native land, where a group of people settle but remain under the political jurisdiction of their native land; a colony.
example_en: That island was a British colony.

definition: to become wet, damp, moistened.
example_en: The ground became damp with the rain.

definition: a language of Muslim people in India and Pakistan, with the same basic grammar as Hindi but having many words derived from Persian and Arabic, and written with Persian-Arabic letters; Urdu.
example: ಆ ಗಾಯಕ ಹಿಂದುಸ್ತಾನಿ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That singer sang beautifully in the Hindustani (Urdu) language.

definition: (dance.) a particular stance.
example_en: The dancer stood in the dusi stance.

definition: a sort of deadly poison.
example: ಶಿವನು ಹಾಲಾಹಲ ವಿಷವನ್ನು ಕುಡಿದು ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: Shiva drank the deadly poison halahala and saved the world.

definition: a bathing by immersing oneself in water.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗುಮೀಹ ಮಾಡಿ ಅವನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿದನು.
example_en: After bathing by immersing himself in the river in the morning, he returned home.

definition: a violent storm with high winds; tornado; hurricane.
example: ತೂಫಾನು ಬಂದ ಕಾರಣ ದೋಣಿಗಳು ಸಮುದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because a hurricane came, the boats did not go out to sea.

definition: the state of being a god; godhood.
example_en: By the fruit of his merit, he attained godhood.

definition: immediately; quickly.
example_en: Seeing the danger, he ran quickly.

definition: wife of one's maternal uncle.
example_en: The maternal uncle's wife came home and asked after everyone.

definition: a crowded place.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯ ದಿನ ಆ ಅಟ್ಟಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಸಂದಣಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: On the fair day, there was a crowd at that crowded place.

definition: an old measure of quantity or weight (2.5 seers).
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಒಂದು ಅಡಿಸೇರು ಅಕ್ಕಿ ತೂಕ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed one adiseru of rice.

definition: the outpost of patrol guards.
example_en: An outpost of patrol guards has been set up near the border.

definition: a (mere) dipping in water for bathing, without washing the body properly; a bath taken hurriedly.
example_en: In a hurry he took a quick dip bath and left.

definition: a result of thinking; idea, concept, opinion, etc.; a thought or chain of thoughts.
example_en: The idea of this poem is very deep.

definition: the cessation of life; death.
example: ಆ ಮುದುಕನ ಮಿೞ್ತು ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನೇ ದುಃಖಕ್ಕೀಡುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The old man's death saddened the whole village.

definition: a pair of umbrellas (used as a mark of respect by king, deities etc.).
example_en: They stood holding the pair of umbrellas in front of the temple.

definition: an editing of an old text, picking up good and sensible portions from different manuscripts.
example_en: The scholars did an editing of the old text, choosing the best portions from different manuscripts.

definition: mild light.
example_en: Mild light spread inside the room.

definition: swiftly and hoppingly.
example: ಆ ಮೊಲ ಪುಣಪುಣನೆ ಹಾರುತ್ತಾ ಪೊದೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಮರೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That rabbit disappeared into the bush, hopping swiftly.

definition: (collectively) weapons of different kinds.
example_en: The soldiers set out for war carrying various kinds of weapons.

definition: to be hanging loosely; to be dangling.
example_en: The tip of the vine was dangling in the wind.

definition: the cutting edge of a sword.
example_en: The cutting edge of that sword was as hard as stone.

definition: a man who has expert knowledge in artistic quality, ability or work and keen discrimination in art; a connoisseur.
example_en: The connoisseur appreciated the music concert.

definition: a female singer.
example_en: The female singer sang a song at the village festival.

definition: the amount of money asked or paid for something; price.
example_en: The price of this item is very high.

definition: to present a drama; to stage a play.
example_en: The students staged a play at the school.

definition: the plant Basella rubra of Basellaceae family; Indian spinach.
example_en: The red Indian spinach vine had spread all over the fence.

definition: a person who supervises; a superintendent; a manager; a presiding officer.
example_en: That supervisor looks after all the workers.

definition: a tall basket used as a corn-storing bin.
example_en: The farmer stored the paddy in the corn-bin.

definition: to move or go aside.
example_en: He moved aside to give way.

definition: a large number of virtues (as found in one person).
example_en: That teacher is found to have countless virtues.

definition: (used to modify the verb turn) with whir sound.
example_en: The door turned with a whirring sound.

definition: to stir (a liquid) thoroughly.
example_en: The cook stirred the broth thoroughly.

definition: one of the men who heralds by turn; an official herald.
example_en: The herald rose in the morning and proclaimed the news.

definition: a courageous, undaunted man.
example_en: The courageous soldier defended the fort.

definition: (dia.) an animal, esp. a cow that is estrus (that is, state of being sexually excited).
example: ಅದಿರೆದನವು ಬೆದೆಗೆ ಬಂದ ಹಸುವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಗಂಡು ಹಸುವಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಲು ಬಯಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The cow in estrus is one that has come into heat and seeks to mate with a bull.

definition: a favourable condition; agreeableness; appropriateness.
example_en: Getting such a favourable situation is rare.

definition: to hold; to seize.
example_en: He firmly seized the thief's hand.

definition: all the nerve cells and nervous tissues in an organism, including, in the vertebrates, the brain, spinal cord, ganglia, nerves, and nerve centres, which coordinates and controls responses to stimuli and conditions behaviour and consciousness; the nervous system.
example_en: His nervous system was damaged due to the accident.

definition: measurement of temperature; the act or process involved therein; thermometry.
example_en: The scientists discovered a new method of temperature measurement.

definition: a kind of paddy.
example_en: They harvested the hudukalani variety of paddy.

definition: stirring about.
example_en: There were some stirring, agitating people in that group.

definition: a ear-ornament worn by women at the top of the helix.
example_en: The golden ear-ornament shone in her ear.

definition: the early stage of one's life; childhood, boyhood or girlhood.
example_en: In her childhood, she was very active.

definition: either of the two beams of a bullock-cart, fixed parellel to and on either side of the main beam, to which side pegs are fixed.
example_en: They had fixed a wooden peg to the beam of the bullock-cart.

definition: a word or a combination of words by which a person, place or thing, a body or class or any object of thought is designated, called or known; a name.
example_en: His name is well known to everyone in the village.

definition: free from any adulterant; unmixed; pure; clear.
example: ಅವಳು ಅಪ್ಪಟ ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಹನಿ ನೀರೂ ಬೆರೆಸದೆ ಕುಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She drank pure milk without mixing even a drop of water.

definition: a male parent; a father.
example_en: That child's father was a farmer.

definition: the moon.
example_en: The moonlight illuminated the whole town.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example: ಬಂದಾರಿಕೆ ಗಿಡವು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The parasitic plant grows on a big tree.

definition: the finger nearest the smallest one in the human hand; the ring finger.
example_en: She wore the ring on her ring finger.

definition: a long shaft with a broad blade at one end, used as a lever for rowing a boat.
example: ದೋಣಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಲು ಅವನು ತುಡುಪನ್ನು ಬಿಗಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಿಡಿದನು.
example_en: He held the oar shaft tightly to row the boat.

definition: the black bumble-bee.
example_en: The bumble-bee flew off after sucking nectar from the flower.

definition: the act or an instance of correcting.
example_en: The teacher made corrections to the essay.

definition: a position or space beside one; a side.
example_en: He changed his side due to pain.

definition: the hermaphroditic form of Śiva as half-man and half-woman, symbolising his transcendental wholeness in which both are integrated.
example_en: The idol of Ardhanarishvara indicates Shiva's unity.

definition: a place for dwelling; a house.
example_en: He lived happily in his dwelling.

definition: the plant Dolichos lablab ( = Lablab niger) of Papilionaceae family.
example: ಈ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮರೆ ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The lablab creeper grows abundantly in this region.

definition: the death sentence by hanging.
example: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಆ ಅಪರಾಧಿಗೆ ಫಾಸಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The court sentenced that criminal to death by hanging.

definition: the separation of lovers or friends.
example_en: War caused the separation of many lovers.

definition: to give, send or do (something) what has been given or sent.
example_en: He returned the money he had borrowed.

definition: a brilliant electric spark discharge in the atmosphere, occurring within a thundercloud, between clouds or between a cloud and the ground; lightning.
example_en: The lightning flashed brightly between the clouds.

definition: a speech in praise of someone.
example_en: A speech in praise of the teacher took place in the assembly.

definition: to knock down and trample.
example_en: The oxen knocked down and trampled the field ridge.

definition: to cut and fell (something) down.
example_en: The woodcutter cut and felled the fallen tree.

definition: a secret - a) something kept hidden or unexplained; b) something kept from the knowledge of others or shared only confidentially with a few; c) a method, formula, process or technique used in an art or a manufacturing operation and divulged only to those of one's own company or craft.
example_en: Nobody found out his secret.

definition: utter dislike or disregard.
example: ಅವನ ಸೋಮಾರಿತನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹೇಡನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: People had utter disregard for his laziness.

definition: a very sharp spear, lance or javelin.
example_en: The hunter took the sharp spear and went into the forest.

definition: a great misfortune or disaster.
example_en: A great disaster struck that village.

definition: a low, indistinct talk by a person from dissatisfaction, suppressed anger, disappointment, etc.
example_en: He sat muttering indistinctly in anger.

definition: a multitude; a crowd.
example_en: A crowd of people had gathered at the fair.

definition: matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid; sediment.
example_en: Sediment settled at the bottom of the milk.

definition: the precious yellow metallic element, highly malleable and ductile, and not subject to oxidation or corrosion (symbol: Au); gold.
example_en: There was a gold necklace around her neck.

definition: a wielding of a cudgel, club, mainly for dispersing a crowd.
example_en: The police carried out a lathi charge to disperse the crowd.

definition: to become stiff from cold.
example_en: His hands became stiff from the cold.

definition: a trainer of horses.
example: ಅವನು ರಾಜನ ಆಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಶ್ವಶಿಕ್ಷಕನಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He worked as a horse trainer in the king's court.

definition: odd, eccentric behaviour.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing his eccentric behaviour.

definition: a fortified place; a fort.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ದುಗ್ಗ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: The fort atop that hill still stands strong even today.

definition: the act of opening one's eyes.
example_en: At that sound he opened his eyes.

definition: a sitting, with the body weight being on the feet, legs folded at the knees and without resting the buttocks on the floor.
example: ಮಗು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಕ್ಕುರುಗಾಲು ಹಾಕಿ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The child sat in the kukkurugālu posture on the floor.

definition: devoted to other's welfare or interested and not one's own; selfless.
example_en: The town benefited from his selfless service.

definition: a religious rite performed when a child is born, being one of the sixteen rites to be performed during that person's life.
example_en: After the child was born, they performed the birth rite.

definition: a very old (in terms of age); aged.
example_en: Everyone shows respect to the grandfather, who is very aged.

definition: the climber Trichosanthes anguina of Cucurbitaceae family.
